title: Navigation — Multi-Mode Receiver Installation for Surveillance Broadcast Compliance
abstract: Replacement of the standalone global positioning receiver by a multi-mode receiver whose position integrity meets the surveillance broadcast mandate, together with the tray and antenna feed change it requires.

sections.planning_reason: Airspace mandates in two regions require automatic dependent surveillance broadcast out with a position source meeting a defined integrity containment radius. The standalone receiver fitted to the classic fleet does not publish the integrity figure of merit at the required rate and cannot be made to do so, so an equipment change is unavoidable. Roughly 780 aircraft are affected and an unmodified aircraft cannot be dispatched into the mandated airspace after the compliance date.
sections.description: This Service Bulletin removes the standalone global positioning receiver and installs a multi-mode receiver that also provides the landing system function, so that one line replaceable unit replaces two. The mounting tray is replaced with the new connector keying and the antenna feed is re-routed.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Get access to the avionics racks in zones 262 and 263. Remove the obsolete computer assembly D3450128295476 and the superseded mounting tray D3450128437161. Install the new tray on the interface at FIN 172TR7 and check the connector keying against drawing D34501177112. Re-route the antenna feed and re-terminate the transceiver at FIN 4DA1. Remove the tray at FIN 32DA and blank the vacated rack position. Install the multi-mode receiver and the display unit D3450125988160. Do the receiver built-in test and confirm that the integrity figure of merit is published at the required rate. Do a ground surveillance broadcast check with the ramp test set and confirm the transmitted position quality indicators. Insert the aircraft flight manual supplement and record the embodiment. The software load and the surveillance configuration are covered by the companion bulletin and must follow this one.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to all classic model ZEPHYR-18, ZEPHYR-20, ZEPHYR-22 and ZEPHYR-24 aircraft that carry the standalone receiver. Aircraft delivered after the production cut-in already have the multi-mode receiver. This bulletin covers the hardware only; the aircraft is not compliant until the companion software load bulletin has also been embodied.
sections.material_note: Kit K3450-1207-01 contains the receiver, the tray, the display unit and the antenna feed set for one aircraft. Lead time was reduced to six weeks after the supplier ramped to 90 units per month. Removed receivers are returned to Aeralis.

type_data.compliance_time: Before operation in airspace subject to the surveillance broadcast mandate, and in any case before the date given in the airworthiness directive.
